binding_rules.production_selection: Any new production/runtime factory that executes missions MUST construct the canonical pair: MissionController(P2) over ExecutionEngine(P1).
binding_rules.legacy_isolation: P4 and P5 must never be auto-selected as the production execution path by any factory, entrypoint, or default configuration. Entrypoints that still use them are legacy surfaces and are recorded in the exclusivity audit (E2-R2/containment-audit.json §path-exclusivity).
binding_rules.no_deletion_no_migration: This phase deletes nothing and migrates nothing. P3/P4/P5/P6 remain in place with their classifications.
binding_rules.single_canonical_claim: No module other than P1+P2 may describe itself (docstring, API, UI) as the production-canonical execution path.
